# CaroCakes

Official site: https://carocakes.md

CaroCakes creates custom cakes, wedding cakes, baptism cakes, birthday cakes, minimalist cakes, luxury cakes, macarons, cupcakes, individual desserts, fine cookies and candy bar concepts in Chișinău, Moldova.

- Russian: https://carocakes.md/ru

Pricing policy:
Exact prices are calculated individually depending on cake weight, composition, design complexity, handmade decor, event date, delivery or pickup, and urgency.
